title: AI Multi-Agent Research Studio
description: Autonomous multi-agent research studio powered by LangChain, LangGraph, Groq, and Tavily. Performs deep web searches, primary source extraction, structured report synthesis, and automated critical peer review.

title: Citation Network Paper Classification (GNN)
description: End-to-end Graph Neural Network (GCN) classification system trained on the Cora Citation Dataset. Features an ONNX Runtime inference engine, a FastAPI web service, and an interactive Citation Network Console UI.

title: StayPredict NYC — Airbnb Room Classifier & SaaS
description: AI-powered Airbnb room type classification engine and SaaS interface built with FastAPI, Scikit-Learn, and 48,000+ NYC listing records.

title: Sasta PDF — Acrobat-Style AI Document Workspace
description: Adobe Acrobat-inspired AI document workspace powered by FastAPI, ChromaDB, Mistral AI embeddings, and ultra-fast Groq LPU inference for high-speed document question answering.

title: CityFlix — Real-Time City Intelligence Agent
description: Netflix-styled real-time Global City Intelligence Agent powered by LangChain, Groq, OpenWeather, Tavily, and Human-in-the-Loop tool verification.

title: AI Video & Meeting Intelligence Assistant
description: Intelligent AI video and meeting assistant that transcribes audio/video recordings with Whisper, extracts executive summaries & action items via Groq, and enables RAG chat using ChromaDB & Mistral AI.

title: Real-Time Emotion Classifier (Bidirectional GRU)
description: Real-time emotion classification from text using Bidirectional GRUs, Keras 3, and FastAPI for sentiment inference and affective computing.

title: Movie Recommendation Engine
description: Content-based movie recommendation system evaluating metadata, cast, director, and genre similarity using cosine distance and TF-IDF text modeling.
